name: CoastRs First Aid and CPR rebate (Gold Coast)
summary: CoastRs members get $50 back on a full First Aid course or $30 on a CPR-only course.
key: Can request a rebate of $50 for full First Aid courses OR $30 for CPR-only courses.
who: SCU students who are current 2026 CoastRs members.
how: Email hello@coastrs.com.au your receipt, certificate and bank details.
catches: One rebate per member per year.
Available from 1 January 2026 until funding runs out.
